codeReview.summary: The implementation perfectly fulfills the friction-loop specification. It properly sets up an EventEmitter-based engine that handles validation failures, tracks iterations per-feature, implements the 3-step escalation ladder (retry, replan, human-intervention), stops re-enqueuing after the cap, and properly bypasses the escalation counter for transient errors.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker spent multiple iterations debugging synchronous event emissions vs async test listeners. It eventually wrapped all engine 	his.emit() calls in setImmediate() so the waitForEvent test utility could catch them. This async event testing pattern should be documented in .factory/library to avoid wasted worker cycles.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows 5 successive edits to friction-loop.cjs wrapping emit calls in setImmediate after test timeouts.

summary: Review passed. The friction-loop engine accurately implements all requested validation failure escalation rules. The worker followed the TDD workflow closely.
